resolution.summary: Implemented classic-only canonical transcription.classic.edit checkpoints, per-window caption publication and awaited atomic persistence. Source-bound mapping tolerates timeline moves/splits/retiming/scene switches and keeps removed-source words archived. Identical replay is idempotent; active Undo is reconciled. Project reopen resumes running jobs; explicit cancel pauses durably; partial transcript consumers await completion. Rebuilt browser runtime WASM/manifests. Real Chrome fixture confirmed first-section visibility, persistence through reload, then continuation at moved source times 81s/141s with three cues and no loss. Screenshot: .local/transcription-debug/incremental-checkpoints.png.

remaining.summary: Full three-hour speech-model inference on the user's recording was not repeated for this change. Recovery cannot guarantee continued processing during persistent browser/GPU/storage or missing-media failures; completed canonical checkpoints are retained.
